description.value: Cozy Bean Bakery is a neighbourhood cafe and bakery in Downtown Langley, BC, run by owner Antonella, whose family recipes and scratch baking are the heart of the operation. The menu spans espresso drinks, teas, freshly baked pastries, hearty soups, and sandwiches — a practical fuel stop for cyclists riding the Fraser Valley corridor. The cafe also hosts community events and offers full catering services.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: bollard (2 spaces) at 49m; stands (4 spaces) at 84m; stands (2 spaces) at 91m. Total: 8 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and provides address (20493 Fraser Hwy, Langley, BC V3A 4G3), phone (778-366-2148), and full menu content, all consistent with the OSM record. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any cycling-specific amenities anywhere on the site. The events page lists only 2024 events, which is over two years stale as of today (May 2026), raising a mild concern about whether the website is actively maintained; however, the OSM record shows looks_closed=false and the site content is otherwise fully intact.
concerns: Events page shows only May 2024 events; website does not appear to have been updated in over two years — worth a periodic recheck to confirm the business remains open.
Email address appears inconsistently on the website: 'info@cozybeanbakery.ca' in the contact form area vs. 'info@cozybeanbakery.com' in the footer.
OSM record has no phone number; phone 778-366-2148 sourced from website only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active cafe with a live website, full menu, and consistent contact details — a practical food-and-drink stop for cyclists on the Fraser Valley route.
